kernel: the keyed Gumbel-max sampler (the msv_keyed_sample Metal kernel plus its host noise twin) and its acceptance use: verify rows, drafts and correction draws keyed by (seed, absolute position, token id)
summary: A Metal Gumbel-max sampler whose noise is splitmix64 of the request seed, the token's absolute position and the token id, so every seeded sampled draw on a row-exact install shares the serial step's key and byte-identical output survives the drafter and a prefix-cache hit. Armed with ModelConfig.rowExactDecode plus Metal, it serves temperature/top-k/top-p/min_p sampling; with a DFlash drafter bound and exact MTP acceptance it becomes the accept rule itself, a draft staying only when it equals the verify row's draw. The lossy Typical and TokenV3 acceptance modes live beside it in mtp_acceptance.zig and never take that path.

models.name: Qwen3.8-27B
models.quant: MLX affine 4-bit, group 64 (the row kernels also take 6 and 8 bits)
models.role: primary: the row-exact + DFlash2 install whose sampled verify rows and drafts take the keyed sampler

models.name: Qwen3.8 Flash-Next
models.role: the lossy acceptance ladder machine (Typical 0.2 and TokenV3 0.95 against exact)

models.name: Nemotron-H and Qwen3.5 installs
models.role: the 2026-09-27 drafted-vs-serial and cache-hit replay incident whose fix was keyed_sample plus position_base = full prompt length

settings.name: key_composition
settings.value: seed, absolute position, token id, mixed by three splitmix64 rounds in that order; the token id enters last and raw
settings.condition: every draw, kernel and host twin
settings.note: kernel tf_uniform at src/keyed_sample.zig:18-23; host twin gumbel at src/keyed_sample.zig:282-288

settings.name: seed_offset
settings.condition: added to the request seed before the first mix round
settings.note: the same golden-ratio constant keys the stock non-keyed seeded path's MLX RNG key (src/generate.zig:14188)

settings.name: position_multiplier
settings.condition: the position is truncated to u32, multiplied by this, then xor'd in
settings.note: host truncate at src/keyed_sample.zig:284; the kernel positions buffer is uint32, so keys wrap past 2^32

settings.name: uniform_bits
settings.condition: u = (float(x >> 40) + 0.5) / 2^24, the top 24 bits of the final mix

settings.name: gumbel_score
settings.value: v/T - log(-log(u)); ties go to the earlier candidate in the (value desc, id asc) order
settings.condition: over the kept candidates after temperature, top_k, top_p and min_p
settings.note: host twin at src/keyed_sample.zig:287; consumed off-kernel by the DFlash tree lattice noise (src/generate.zig:6587)

settings.name: candidates_cap
settings.condition: most candidates a row sorts; tokens within the near window of the max are gathered directly, otherwise a radix select finds the C largest
settings.note: rides the Metal pipeline as template constant C (src/keyed_sample.zig:267)

settings.name: near_window
settings.condition: the fast gather takes the widest of 20, 10, 5 whose count fits the candidate cap and holds the rule's candidates; past all three a radix select runs
settings.note: window rule at src/keyed_sample.zig:79-100, cfg[2] carries NEAR (src/keyed_sample.zig:311)

settings.name: top_p_window_margin
settings.condition: the fast window must hold (top_p + 1e-4) of the whole-row softmax to be trusted

settings.name: threadgroup_threads
settings.condition: one threadgroup per row, 32 simdgroups (NSG = TG / 32)
settings.note: grid is 1024 * rows with threadgroup 1024 (src/keyed_sample.zig:264-265), part of the per-(rows, vocab) config cache key

settings.name: max_rows_per_call
settings.condition: sample() returns error.TooManyRows past 64 rows per dispatch; every shipped call site passes one row
settings.note: verifySerialSamples slices verify logits per row and samples one row at a time (src/generate.zig:6965-6978); the multi-row form is exercised by tests only at this rev

settings.name: temperature_floor
settings.condition: the host passes 1 / max(temperature, 1e-6) as inv_t; requests under 0.01 take the argmax path before the sampler runs

settings.name: position_base_rule
settings.value: absolute position of generated token 0 = full prompt length (the lookup prompt when one is supplied), never the uncached suffix; a draw's key position is position_base + draw index
settings.note: the draw index enters at src/generate.zig:13947; the scheduler passes slot.full_prompt (src/scheduler.zig:8726) so a prefix-cache hit leaves the base unchanged, and the restored-prefix offset rides a separate field (src/scheduler.zig:8728)

settings.name: verify_row_key_rule
settings.value: verify row i keys generated index G + 1 + i (t1 sits at G); a tree row keys G + 1 + depth[i]; the DFlash lattice noise keys position_base + generated + 1 + d per candidate; a correction or bonus draw keys generated + accepted + 2; a coupled MTP draft keys chain.pos0 + i
settings.condition: speculative rounds of a seeded keyed request
settings.note: tree lattice base at src/generate.zig:6585, correction draw at src/generate.zig:5116, coupled draft at src/generate.zig:7613, the one request-local draw-index allocator that keeps any two keyed draws off one key at src/generate.zig:6996-7002

gates.condition: the keyed flag is armed once at Generator init: xfm.config.rowExactDecode() and mlx.metalKernelsAvailable() (the sampler is a Metal kernel)
rowExactDecode = row_exact_covered and dflash_bound and rowExactArch; rowExactArch is nemotron_h, or a qwen3_5 prefix that is not MoE with hadamard_block == 0
gates.note: rowExactArch at src/model.zig:1237; a DFlash-bound config forces MTP acceptance to .exact (src/model.zig:1231)

gates.condition: a sampled request (temperature >= 0.01) takes the keyed draw only with a seed; an unseeded sampled request on a keyed install gets a random u64 from the timestamp xor the Transformer pointer, so drafts and verify rows share the serial sampler's keys
gates.note: seed assignment at src/generate.zig:2757-2760; greedy argmax below 0.01 at src/generate.zig:13937; the sync sampler's twin at src/generate.zig:15326

gates.condition: MTP acceptance becomes serial's own draw only when mtp_serial_accept holds: MTP active, rowExactDecode, and the acceptance mode is .exact; under it the draft is the verify row's keyed draw over the head's logits, a draft stays only while it equals the row's draw, and the Leviathan rejection path is skipped
gates.note: stochastic flag off at src/generate.zig:9504; verify reads verifySerialSamples instead of verifyArgmax at src/generate.zig:9692; coupled-drafts gate at src/generate.zig:6989

gates.condition: DFlash rounds split the same way: serial (keyed, temperature > 0.01, seeded) keeps drafts matching the row's key; stochastic requests take Leviathan rejection min(1, p/q) with q from the proposal
DFlash tree rounds additionally require specTreeSupported: rowExactDecode, MoE layers present, no Hadamard rht, GDN recur enabled, Metal kernels available
gates.note: tree-round pick at src/generate.zig:5701; the lattice's Gumbel noise comes from the host twin (src/generate.zig:6583-6590)

gates.condition: the lossy Typical and TokenV3 acceptance modes are opt-in and mutually exclusive (--mtp-typical d > 0, --mtp-tokenv3 0 <= a <= 1) and never take the keyed serial-draw acceptance, because mtp_serial_accept requires the .exact tag; a lossy mode without batched corrections is a hard error
gates.note: mode install and lossy log lines at src/generate.zig:2950-2962; default thresholds DEFAULT_TYPICAL_DELTA 0.2 and DEFAULT_TOKENV3_ALPHA 0.95 at src/mtp_acceptance.zig:28-29; prefix fns exactPrefix/typicalPrefix/tokenV3Prefix at src/mtp_acceptance.zig:87/97/107, graphs in src/generate.zig:8229/8241

gates.condition: rows past 64 in one sample() call return error.TooManyRows
runtime acceptance gate: per-draft acceptance under 0.50 after 5 attempts (SPEC_GATE_WARMUP overridable in [1, 64]) disables speculation for the rest of the request, sticky
gates.note: warmup constant at src/generate.zig:2057; applies to nextPld, nextDrafter and nextDflash (src/generate.zig:2011-2020)

notes: Doc-vs-source: our bullet (MLX_SERVE_KERNELS.md:391) says the hash draws 'each verify row and draft'; the source routes EVERY seeded sampled draw through the kernel on a keyed install, serial tokens included (src/generate.zig:13944), and verify rows and drafts merely reuse the serial keys, so the doc understates the coverage. Our '+16 to +27% on their 1K to 1M ladder' for the lossy modes matches the ladder endpoints but the arms were joint (lossy verifier plus paired routed gate/up kernel plus an RNG fix) and the record says not to attribute them to the verifier alone; the isolated verifier-only comparison is the M5 Max table recorded above. The prefix-cache-hit claim is structural in the source (position_base is the full prompt length even on warm reuse) and their incident note pins the guard to 'seeded cold==warm in tests/test_hybrid_reuse_equivalence.sh' (docs/gotchas/engine-mlx.md:5294-5315), a test file this entry did not read. Caveats: the kernel is ported from TensorFold's gpu_sampling.py (MIT, per the file header and NOTICE) and its correctness pin is the test drawing TensorFold's reference tokens (src/keyed_sample.zig:341-376) plus the host-noise-picks-the-token test (378-408); the host gumbel twin must stay bit-identical to the kernel's tf_uniform because the DFlash tree lattice consumes the host twin; key positions wrap past 2^32 since the position enters as u32 on both sides; the noise uses only the top 24 bits of the 64-bit mix; the stock non-keyed seeded path keys MLX's categorical RNG with seed + draw * golden ratio and no position (src/generate.zig:14188), so a non-row-exact install's rejection-sampling corrections share none of these guarantees; the unseeded request seed comes from the wall clock and the Transformer pointer (src/generate.zig:2758), so only an explicitly requested seed replays; no performance number for the sampler itself appears anywhere in the repo at this rev.
